name: Signed-Ideal Colon Identity for Sections
statement: For any finite class $M$ with nonempty marked section $C=M[\tau]$ on visible coordinates $X$, if $m_\tau$ is the product of the marked auxiliary literals, then $Q_C=(Q_M:m_\tau)\cap S_X$.
proof: The contracted colon is generated by visible restrictions of missing parent patterns whose auxiliary signs agree with the mark, so every generator is missing from the section. Conversely, extend a minimally missing pattern of $C$ by the mark and minimize it inside $M$; the resulting active parent generator has visible restriction dividing the original pattern. These containments prove equality for every monomial.
